# KK Coaching

> Personal training in Cwmbran, Wales and online fitness coaching across the UK, founded by Kacper Kaszowski. Coaching is available in English and Polish.

KK Coaching provides individual 1:1 personal training, online coaching and hybrid coaching. Face-to-face sessions take place at JD Gyms Cwmbran, 17–18 Gwent Square, Cwmbran, NP44 1PW. Kacper Kaszowski is a Level 3 Personal Trainer and Level 2 Gym Instructor.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://kkcoaching.fit/): KK Coaching overview, services, results and consultation route.
- [Personal Training Cwmbran](https://kkcoaching.fit/personal-training-cwmbran): 1:1 personal training at JD Gyms Cwmbran.
- [Online Personal Training UK](https://kkcoaching.fit/online-coaching): remote coaching with individual programming, nutrition targets, check-ins, progress tracking and technique feedback.
- [Hybrid Personal Training Cwmbran](https://kkcoaching.fit/hybrid-coaching): online coaching combined with scheduled face-to-face sessions in Cwmbran.
- [Client Transformations](https://kkcoaching.fit/transformations): consented KK Coaching client progress stories.
- [About Kacper Kaszowski](https://kkcoaching.fit/about): coach background, transformation story and completed qualifications.
- [Contact](https://kkcoaching.fit/contact): free consultation and contact options.
